LESSON: COMPUTER HARDWARE

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Tools and Production
Topic 4.2: Computer Hardware

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Computer Hardware. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Computer Hardware
2. Practise Computer Hardware at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Computer Hardware

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Computer Hardware
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Computer Hardware. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Computer Hardware at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Computer Hardware at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Computer Hardware
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Computer Hardware. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Computer Hardware using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Computer Hardware in the examples.
2. Explain Computer Hardware to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Computer Hardware.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Computer Hardware using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Computer Hardware important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Computer Hardware
2. Practise Computer Hardware at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Computer Hardware

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
